db_evidence.notes: Both clue intervals are directly present and unambiguous in the episodes table at 30sec granularity: episodes:30sec:000040 (1200-1230s) shows the 定身法/Immobilize skill-learn overlay, and episodes:30sec:000223 (6690-6720s) shows an explicit skill-learn interface overlay naming 聚形散气/Cloud Step. Black Bear Guai (黑熊精/黑风怪 reference) is discussed in the same 6690s clip and the boss fight itself begins around 7260-7290s per all rollouts' own SQL. Rock Solid (铜头铁臂, 18060-18210s) and Movement Outside the Body (身外身法, 14910s) are both clearly after 7260s in every rollout's retrieval. The DB also contains several LATER rows (e.g. 51810s, 8130s, 25830s, 30660s+) that mention the same spell names in passing (menu browsing, HUD icons, item descriptions) without being the acquisition event, which is a plausible distractor for a keyword/LIKE search.

root_causes: Rollout 3 scored 2 because it misidentified the acquisition time of Cloud Step (聚形散气): its own broad keyword SQL query correctly returned the true 6690s 'skill-learn overlay' row alongside multiple later rows that merely mention or display the already-owned spell (e.g. 51810s menu-browsing row), and the agent selected one of the later distractor rows as if it were the learning event, flipping the before/after relationship to Black Bear Guai (~7260s) and dropping option 1 from the final answer.

The other four rollouts avoided this by either querying a time window tightly bounded around the clue interval and the boss encounter (rollouts 2 and 4), or by cross-checking event_steps/topic_facts alongside episodes so a single ambiguous keyword hit could be corroborated (rollouts 0, 1), which made the true 6690s learn-event stand out from later passive mentions.
what_worked: All 5 rollouts correctly retrieved the Immobilize (定身法, 1200-1230s) and Black Bear Guai (~7260s) anchor times with no disagreement across rollouts.

4/5 rollouts correctly disambiguated the true Cloud Step acquisition event (6690s, explicit 'skill-learn overlay') from later re-displays of the same spell name by either narrowing the SQL time window near the clue interval or cross-referencing multiple tables (event_steps/topic_facts) before committing to a timestamp.
transferable_lessons: When a keyword/LIKE search for a spell or item name returns many rows spanning a huge time range, do not pick just any matching row as the 'acquisition' event -- read the row text closely for an explicit acquisition/learn signal (e.g. 'skill-learn interface overlay appears', 'unlock popup') versus a mere later mention (menu browsing, HUD icon display, item description referencing the spell).

For before/after questions about an ordered sequence of acquisition events, prefer narrowing the SQL time window to bracket the target event (here, the Black Bear Guai encounter) rather than scanning the entire timeline, since a full-timeline keyword scan surfaces many false-positive distractor rows that reference the same term without being the acquisition moment.

When multiple candidate rows match the same keyword, cross-check against a second, structurally different table (event_steps, topic_facts) or against the temporal ordering implied by neighboring gameplay content, rather than trusting the first or an arbitrary matching row.
